collection.canonical_json_digest_convention: UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true and separators comma/colon, without a final newline; path arrays sorted by path.
collection.git_blob_convention: SHA-1 of ASCII blob, space, decimal byte length, NUL, and exact bytes; independently compared with committed Git blob objects where present. Working hashes were calculated without adding objects to Git.
collection.git_mode_convention: Regular file 100755 if the POSIX owner execute bit is set, otherwise 100644. POSIX mode is also recorded separately.
collection.method: Python standard-library raw byte hashing and file-mode inspection; read-only git rev-parse, ls-tree and cat-file. No repository module was imported.
collection.observation_limit: Two matching observations are not an atomic repository snapshot and cannot exclude intervening or malicious concurrent writes. Later changes require a new explicit observation.
collection.sha256_convention: SHA-256 of exact file bytes without text normalization.
